ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface area with approximately 85% coverage; high-intensity (white/light-grey) pixels are localized to the fluke base and central-left interior.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe: Diffused mid-intensity grey mottled cluster in the central interior. Right lobe: Near-uniform low-intensity black field. Base/Peduncle junction: Horizontal band of high-intensity white pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped central depression with an estimated interior angle of 50-60 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Right lobe: High-amplitude, irregular jagged peaks and deep valleys. Left lobe: Lower-amplitude, high-frequency serrations following a continuous arc.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve sweeping from the central notch toward sharply pointed lateral tips with a dorsal orientation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced irregular indentation or major notch on the superior-medial section of the right fluke lobe trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant morphological asymmetry in the edge topography between the left and right lobes.
